notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

uses.name: Aminatou, the Fateshifter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

uses.name: Spark Double
uses.cardState: as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it
